route_definition: unique one-way geometric route, including identical service connectors; common window clipping

table_xii_measures.length_per_area: unique one-way mapped route length / common window area (km/km2)
table_xii_measures.length_per_connection: unique route length / 85 observed transfer points (m/point)
table_xii_measures.connection_spacing: mean nearest-neighbour distance of observed transfer points (m); input control
table_xii_measures.building_to_network_distance: mean minimum distance from every eligible OSM building centroid to route union (m)
table_xii_measures.branch_length: mean branch length between degree-not-equal-to-2 nodes after common 0.5-m geometry quantisation and noding (m)
table_xii_measures.terminal_share: degree-1 nodes / nodes in the degree-2-suppressed inferred route graph

connection_locations: fixed observed inputs; connection spacing is a control
dependent_measures: Length per area and length per connection are two normalisations of the same route extent; do not count them as independent evidence
building_filter: OSM polygons of at least 20 m2 whose centroid is within the fixed window
calibration: No installed route length, morphology, overlap, or proximity score is used to select model parameters
interpretation: Conditional mapped-route reconstruction; the cadastral transfer-point layer is not assumed to enumerate all actual customers
